deathcrush.cpp:77 writes this output with setVoltage and no channel index

comment: The first drive crossfades the input against a signed tangent of its fourth root, scaled by 0.75 (deathcrush.cpp:66). The second acts only where the size of the input passes one minus the knob, so turning it up both lowers the threshold and mixes in more of the full-scale value (deathcrush.cpp:68 to :71). The crusher rounds to two to the power of the knob minus one, over a knob range of 1 to 12 bits (deathcrush.cpp:51, :73 to :75).
